content.title: What Is Catechism? · Commentary prolegomena
content.author: Zacharias Ursinus
content.note: An introductory excerpt from the Heidelberg Catechism commentary, not the complete commentary. Sections III–IV explain the distinction between law and gospel and the order of misery, deliverance and gratitude.
